newsitem.title: INDIA: India Zandu Pharma up 4 pct on bonus.
newsitem.headline: India Zandu Pharma up 4 pct on bonus.

text.p: Shares of India's Zandu Pharmaceutical Works surged 132.25 rupees, or nearly four percent, to 3,553.0 at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Wednesday ahead of a bonus issue announcement, trader said.
Earlier, the Bombay Stock Exchange in a notice said the board of Zandu Pharmaceutical will meet today to consider a bonus share issue.
The firm will also consider its accounts and dividend at the meeting, the exchange said.
Zandu shares rose 224.70 rupees, or seven percent, to 3,434.70 at the National Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
